title: JUDGEBOARD: Benchmarking and Enhancing Small Language Models for Reasoning Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating mathematical and scientific reasoning capabilities in language models using benchmarks like MATH, GSM8K, ARC, and GPQA. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, ethics, or spiritual traditions. The presence of an 'Ethics Statement' at the end of the paper pertains to standard research conduct and does not constitute a subject-matter evaluation of morality or ethics.
